correctness.rationale: The equal-edge coordinates and explicit ten outward facet normals induce all silhouette vertices by mixed signs among incident faces for generic directions. Four sign thresholds in the 0<φ<π/4 sector yield the five w-intervals with 6,5,6,7,8 vertices. Spherical area integration using F(w)=w/sqrt(1+w²) and G gives all four formulas, total one; the independent exterior dihedral-angle mean agrees. A separately written projected-hull test agreed with facet-regime classification on 2500 uniformly generated directions and direct quadrature reproduces the four decimals. Exceptional normals are measure-zero and numerical tests are supplementary only.
